title: Multi-Omics Integration Identifies Epithelial-Stromal-Immune Co-Regulators Bridging Ulcerative Colitis and Colorectal Cancer.
snippet: Patients with ulcerative colitis (UC) carry a substantially elevated risk of developing colorectal cancer (CRC); yet, the transcriptional intermediates that bridge chronic mucosal inflammation and colorectal malignancy remain poorly characterized.
